exam.exam_name: Punjab Police Sub-Inspector & Police Constable Recruitment Examination
aliases: Punjab Police SI & Constable Cadre Examination

source_evidence.captured_wording: Upload recent passport size photograph taken against a plain white background. File size must be between 80 KB and 200 KB in JPG/JPEG format.
source_evidence.document_title: Recruitment of Sub-Inspectors and Constables in District & Armed Cadre of Punjab Police

dimensions.fallback_reason: The body publishes a preferred pixel size without mandating it, so the size is honoured while the mode stays unspecified.
dimensions.permitted_pixel_range: 80 KB to 200 KB in JPG/JPEG; TCS iON portal standard

spectacles.condition: No sunglasses; plain vision spectacles allowed if eyes fully visible without reflection
spectacles.source_wording: No sunglasses; plain vision spectacles allowed if eyes fully visible without reflection

headwear.condition: Allowed for religious reasons (e.g. Turban) ensuring face from chin to forehead is fully visible
headwear.source_wording: Allowed for religious reasons (e.g. Turban) ensuring face from chin to forehead is fully visible

requirements.content_instructions: JPG, JPEG; 80 KB to 200 KB in JPG/JPEG; TCS iON portal standard; 3.5 cm x 4.5 cm; Plain white background; Applicant must look straight into the lens; both ears uncovered where practicable
PDF, JPG, JPEG; 100 KB to 2 MB PDF or JPG file; A4 original marksheet; Must clearly show candidate has passed Punjabi at Matriculation examination or equivalent level

image_requirements.file_size.evidence_reference: Recruitment of Sub-Inspectors and Constables in District & Armed Cadre of Punjab Police - Section 11 (Instructions for Online Application) (https://punjabpolice.gov.in/recruitment/notice_punjab_police_2024.pdf)
image_requirements.file_size.reasoning: Byte ceiling converted from the published figure using 1 KB = 1000 bytes. No body in the researched set defines the unit, and the decimal reading is the smaller of the two, so a file satisfying it also satisfies a 1024-byte reading.

image_requirements.dimensions.evidence_reference: Recruitment of Sub-Inspectors and Constables in District & Armed Cadre of Punjab Police - Section 11 (Instructions for Online Application) (https://punjabpolice.gov.in/recruitment/notice_punjab_police_2024.pdf)
image_requirements.dimensions.reasoning: Pixel dimensions transcribed from the cited source.

image_requirements.formats.preferred_for.reasoning: The body lists permitted formats without naming a preference. JPEG is selected from the permitted list; JPG and JPEG name the same format, so this chooses a spelling rather than a format.

image_requirements.composition.crop_prof.reasoning: One composition is used for every examination: the tightest crop that keeps hair, ears and the chin/beard boundary intact. No researched body publishes a coverage maximum this would breach, and all published minima are cleared by it.
